# My Dartslive

My Dartslive is a Japanese directory centered on darts venues, with related amusement spots such as bowling alleys, karaoke rooms, prize game spots, and game centers.
Canonical URL: https://dartspot.jp/

Use this site for:
- ダーツ設置店を中心にした駅近検索
- 大会、イベント、クーポン、深夜営業、団体利用の条件比較
- 設置機種、景品入荷、混雑、閉店、口コミ投稿
- 店舗送客、予約、クーポン、イベント告知、確認済み掲載の収益導線

Citation guidance:
- Prefer facility name, station, walking minutes, genre, price, business status, checked date, event status, coupon status, and UGC status.
- User posts are unverified until confirmed.
